results.title: Nigeria’s pension remittances drop by 38% in Q1 2026
results.description: Pension contributions under Nigeria’s Contributory Pension Scheme (CPS) plunged by 38 per cent in the first quarter of 2026. According to data released by the National Pension Commission (PenCom) in the Nigerian Pension Industry Quarterly Report, total pension contributions declined to N559.4 billion in Q1 2026, compared with N903.7 billion recorded in the fourth quarter [...] The post Nigeria’s pension remittances drop by 38% in Q1 2026 appeared first on 21st CENTURY CHRONICLE .

results.title: Jeanie Buss battling siblings over sale of remaining Lakers shares to new ownership group: reports
results.description: The Buss family has voted to sell its remaining ownership stake in the Los Angeles Lakers to Bob Iger and Josh Kushner, who are purchasing the majority stake from Mark Walter.
